purpose: Design a separate v2 code-domain development cycle after the completed negative v1 confirmatory primary-margin result.

operational_framework_target.goal: Build a practical LM-training-data curation framework, not an intrinsic data-quality measurement tool.
operational_framework_target.input_output_contract: candidate corpus -> supported training release or explicit abstention
operational_framework_target.quality_boundary: Quality is a pre-outcome proxy for observable information-density and structural signals, not ground-truth data quality.
operational_framework_target.release_boundary: The framework may reject or abstain when evidence is missing, guardrails fail, or the candidate corpus lacks enough usable data.

source_postmortem.locked_v1_interpretation: negative primary-margin result with positive directional curation signal
v1_may_be_used_for: designing a separate future development cycle
v1_must_not_be_used_for: retroactively changing the completed confirmatory margin
reclassifying the completed primary-margin failure as a pass

stage_boundaries.utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective

stage_b_v2_proxy_plan.ablation_role: mechanism evidence only; not a post-confirmatory selector search
operational_readiness_checks: harmful duplication separated from useful recurrence
concise examples, tests, bug fixes, and API usage chunks are not systematically discarded
repository, path, and template concentration caps are reported
failure diagnosis is emitted when curated does not beat Stage-A-random

inputs_allowed: v2 development and candidate split profiles
inputs_forbidden: post-freeze confirmatory diagnostics from the same cycle
margin_calibration.freeze_requirement: choose exactly one primary success rule before v2 confirmatory outcomes are read

conditions: curated_v2 beats Stage-A-random on the development primary metric by the frozen development margin or calibrated detectable-effect rule
curated_v2 is directionally no worse than raw-random
all required development training seeds complete or the report is explicitly feasibility-only

claim_boundary: Design draft only. It authorizes no v2 training claim, no confirmatory claim, and no release claim.
